Key logic: read data/sms_status.json via delivery_status(), read outbox sms.jsonl, filter failed ids, for each failed line append a new line with new SMS id (format_sms_id / next_number), same household_id, phone, template_id, params, text, queued_at from now(). Deduplicate per household? R12 says "If a household appears in multiple failed messages, one new text per failed message would be queued unless deduplicated per household." Done when: every household whose text failed gets exactly one new text. So dedupe per household — one new text per household. But "with the same message and details as the original" — if multiple failed messages per household, which one? The findings list 10 failed ids and 10 households, so likely one-to-one. Safest: dedupe per household, take first failed message per household. Actually done-when says "every household whose text failed gets exactly one new text with the same message". So dedupe per household.
